Game Overview

In Poppy Strike 2, the core idea is straightforward: gear up for survival in Poppy Strike 2. Navigate a Minecraft-style world, battling relentless huggy wuggy dolls with a diverse arsenal. Strategize, upgrade your firepower, and overcome waves of enemies. Every second counts in this thrilling test of skill and reflexes—can you survive the ultimate showdown?
